name: Province Natural Shore
reviewBasis: Native bank/shore modules 1374-1393 and all of their cell projections. Original bank sprites span up to twelve map rows; every projected cell retains its full native anchor. Directed neighbours come from BichonProvince, WoomyonWoods(S), WoomyonWoods(N), MongchonProvince, PastBichon, SacredFoxHill and WasteLands maps. Bare land/water adjacency is rejected. Original scene crops and independently generated coast/river prototypes were visually inspected. Fine/rough grass must reach the identical plain-dirt shore centres through separately reviewed native grass/dirt transitions.
